newsitem.title: ITALY: Business chief says Italy industry near recession.
newsitem.headline: Business chief says Italy industry near recession.

text.p: Italian industry is close to, or even already in recession, Giorgio Fossa, the head of business leaders' federation Confindustria, said on Thursday.

"The situation is difficult. At very best we are dealing with stagnation," Fossa told a news conference following data published earlier in the day which showed Italian industrial output rising just 0.6 percent year-on-year in December.
In the same month, industrial orders fell 5.9 percent
